# MakeFlow AI Visibility Report

> A free report that shows Australian business owners how often ChatGPT
> recommends them, who it recommends instead, and what to fix.

MakeFlow is an Australian AI studio. We make businesses visible in AI search,
then build the chatbots and automations that turn it into customers.

## What the report does

- Crawls your website: homepage, service pages, schema, robots.txt, FAQ content
  and whether AI crawlers such as GPTBot are allowed in.
- Writes 30 to 50 questions a real customer in your niche and city would type.
- Runs every question through ChatGPT twice: once with web browsing on, once
  from its own knowledge. Both are scored separately.
- Scores six signals: mention rate (35%), prominence (20%), website
  AI-readiness (15%), citation rate (10%), sentiment (10%) and competitive
  position (10%).
- Returns an on-screen analysis and a branded A4 PDF with a prioritised fix list.

## Pages

- [Home](/): run a free report.
- [Sample report](/report): a full worked example.

## Terms

- AI visibility: how often an AI assistant names your business when someone asks
  it for a recommendation.
- Generative engine optimisation (GEO): the work of getting named in AI answers,
  as distinct from ranking in a list of blue links.
- Browsing mode vs knowledge mode: whether ChatGPT looked at the live web to
  answer, or answered from its training data.

## Contact

MakeFlow, Australia. One free report per email every 30 days.
